changelog: ONT 16S merge mode (Beta): picking folders now ADDS to the selection instead of replacing it, so sample folders can be picked one by one (Sample_L21, then Sample_PGU-16S full…); picking the delivery folder itself still takes every sample at once. New 'Clear selection' button. No backend change.

previous.changelog: new (ONT 16S, Beta): input layout choice — 'One file per sample' (as before) or 'MinKNOW folders — merge per barcode'. In the second mode give the delivery folder's path on this computer (files are linked, not copied), upload the folder, or a .zip of it; the chunk files of each barcode / sample folder are grouped (Sample_L21 → L21, fastq_fail left out), shown in an editable Samples table, and merged into one FASTQ per sample at run time (results/merged_reads/<sample>.fastq.gz + sample_map.csv, included in the download). Fix: cutadapt now removes BOTH primers of a full-length read (-n 2) — before, only one end was trimmed and the other primer, plus any untrimmed barcode flank, stayed on the read. Needs: backend restart (main.py) and Ctrl+F5 on /beta.
